QUOTE: "`scripts/generate_errors.pl` scans `include/mbedtls/*.h` for those defines... `scripts/data_files/error.fmt` is the template. The generator replaces the `HEADER_INCLUDED`, `LOW_LEVEL_CODE_CHECKS` and `HIGH_LEVEL_CODE_CHECKS` placeholders. `library/error.c` is regenerated by `library/Makefile:355-360` (`perl ../scripts/generate_errors.pl`)"
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer states that error.c is generated from the public headers by generate_errors.pl using error.fmt as the template.
